# Calculyx AI

> AI-powered financial intelligence platform: live Top-50 stocks for India (NSE) and the US with AI bull/bear cases, 15 investing calculators, tax/loan/currency planners, and daily AI-summarised market news.

Calculyx AI unifies stock research, financial calculators and AI-driven insights into one dashboard. Every calculator ships with narrative AI analysis, country-aware assumptions (India, USA, UAE) and one-click PDF + Excel exports.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Calculyx AI — stocks, calculators, AI insights.
- [Live Stock Hub](/stocks): Top-50 live prices for Indian & US markets with AI analysis.
- [Investing Calculators](/investing-calculators): 15 tools — SIP, Lumpsum, CAGR, Dividend, Brokerage, FIRE, SWP, Goal Planner and more.
- [All Calculators](/calculators): Currency, mortgage, home loan, tax, GST, salary, property, retirement, inflation, compound interest.
- [AI Assistant](/ai): Ask financial questions and get country-aware AI answers.
- [Market News](/news): AI-summarised financial headlines for India, USA, UAE and global markets.
- [About](/about): What Calculyx AI is and who builds it.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch.
